benchmark_scope.source_permissions: offline fixture snapshots and mocked official API/data routes only

preference_win_rate.reason: Expert preference requires permissioned paired outputs and calibrated reviewer scores. This pack records only deterministic metric deltas.

wins: Upgraded runtime improves grounded claim rate from 0.72 to 0.92.
Unsupported claim rate drops from 0.20 to 0.04.
Accepted-output rate improves from 0.40 to 0.80 while preserving reproducibility.
Freshness and stale-evidence failures drop to zero in the packaged fixture.
Cost per accepted report drops from 0.12 USD to 0.09 USD.
losses: Reviewer disagreement is unchanged in the deterministic fixture.
The pack does not prove expert preference because no human-calibrated paired review is bundled.
unproven: No broad comparison to ChatGPT Deep Research or other proprietary Deep Research-style products is supported.
Live source acquisition quality is unproven because the default benchmark uses offline fixtures and mocked routes.
Generalization beyond climate/coffee economics is unproven.
human_intervention_points: Approve private buyer memo reuse before public claims.
Approve any live external API, paid source, or browser capture.
Calibrate paired reviewers before reporting expert preference win rate.
Approve any public statement comparing against named Deep Research-style products.
allowed_claim: In this packaged climate/coffee economics fixture, the runtime-backed domain pack improves multiple deterministic metrics over the generic baseline.
forbidden_claim: This fixture does not support broad superiority claims over general-purpose Deep Research-style products.
